<module id="multi_pipe_8bit">
    <description>Unsigned 8-bit multiplier implemented with pipelining.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal used for synchronous operation.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active-low reset signal. Defined as 0 for chip reset and 1 for reset signal inactive.</input>
        <input id="mul_en_in">Input enable signal that controls the multiplication operation.</input>
        <input id="mul_a" width_description="[7:0]">Input signal representing the multiplicand with a data width of 8 bits.</input>
        <input id="mul_b" width_description="[7:0]">Input signal representing the multiplier with a data width of 8 bits.</input>
        <output id="mul_en_out">Output enable signal indicating if the multiplication operation is enabled.</output>
        <output id="mul_out" width_description="[15:0]">Product output signal with a data width of 16 bits.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="WIDTH" value="8">Width of the multiplicand and multiplier.</parameter>
        <parameter id="PRODUCT_WIDTH" value="16">Width of the product.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <register id="mul_en_out_reg" width="1">Register to store the output enable signal.</register>
        <register id="mul_a_reg" width="WIDTH">Register to store the multiplicand.</register>
        <register id="mul_b_reg" width="WIDTH">Register to store the multiplier.</register>
        <wire id="temp" width="WIDTH" array_size="WIDTH">Wires to store partial products.</wire>
        <register id="sum" width="WIDTH" array_size="WIDTH">Registers to store intermediate sum values.</register>
        <register id="mul_out_reg" width="PRODUCT_WIDTH">Register to store the final product.</register>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                mul_en_out_reg <= 1'b0;
                mul_a_reg <= {WIDTH{1'b0}};
                mul_b_reg <= {WIDTH{1'b0}};
                mul_out_reg <= {PRODUCT_WIDTH{1'b0}};
            end else begin
                if (mul_en_in) begin
                    mul_en_out_reg <= 1'b1;
                    mul_a_reg <= mul_a;
                    mul_b_reg <= mul_b;
                end else begin
                    mul_en_out_reg <= 1'b0;
                end

                // Partial Product Generation
                for (integer i = 0; i < WIDTH; i = i + 1) begin
                    temp[i] <= mul_a_reg & (mul_b_reg >> i);
                end

                // Partial Sum Calculation
                sum[0] <= temp[0];
                for (integer j = 1; j < WIDTH; j = j + 1) begin
                    sum[j] <= sum[j-1] + temp[j];
                end

                // Final Product Calculation
                mul_out_reg <= sum[WIDTH-1];
            end
        end

        assign mul_en_out = mul_en_out_reg[0];
        assign mul_out = mul_en_out_reg[0] ? mul_out_reg : {PRODUCT_WIDTH{1'b0}};
    </implementation>
</module>
